verdicts.note: Six-term incumbent first elected in 2002 and seeking a seventh term [S2]; unopposed in 2022 [S5]. Two sources; -2 high stands.

Direction and magnitude hold: he runs explicitly on 'Twenty years in office taxing and taxing. It's time for new blood' and has not held elected office [S1]. Confidence is overstated: every element of the basis comes from his one voters' guide statement [S1]. The other sources only confirm residence and the primary result [S3][S4]. A single source does not support high; medium.

'I will exempt, reduce, or remove your property taxes where possible' and 'I cannot afford to continue to pay an ever-increasing amount of taxes' [S1]. The assessor does not set rates, but the axis records orientation, and his is unambiguous. Medium already reflects the single source.

'Streamlining processes, improving services, and reducing costs' without 'impacting personnel', and 'accountability, transparency, and effectiveness' [S1]. Restraint direction, mild and hedged (no staff cuts, 'improving services'), so -1 not -2.
